beats.caption: Summerhill, in Irish Cnoc an tSamhraidh. Here is the story of Summerhill and its 23 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 94, 69 and 23 people in Summerhill, in 16, 13 and 9 households. Heads of household included Barber, Brogan and Broyan.
